notes.title: Full release October 21st!
notes.notes:
We're incredibly excited to announce the full game is coming out October 21st. The new page for the full game is found here
http://store.steampowered.com/app/544270/?snr=1_7_15__13

If you find yourself in Los Angeles, we'll also be throwing a free launch party on October 28th at VR Territory, link can be found here!

https://www.eventbrite.com/e/the-bellows-experience-pure-horror-in-virtual-reality-tickets-28647799339
